GameConditionDef.label: ashmount eruption
GameConditionDef.description: A mountain is open somewhere past the horizon. The ash is falling faster than it settles, the vents here are throwing up what they drag with it, and the ground has not finished moving.
GameConditionDef.letterText:
The sky went the colour of a bruise an hour before anyone felt it. Then the ground moved, once, hard enough to shake grit out of the rafters.

One of the Ashmounts has opened. Whatever runs beneath the ash joins it to the vents on this land, and they are breathing harder for it. The fall will thicken. Metal will come up with it, more than the vents give in a season, and it will not stay uncovered long.

The ground near a mouth will keep shifting until the mountain is finished. Nobody has ever built well next to a vent.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The ground has settled. What is coming down now is only what the Ashmounts always send.
